news.title: Muthoot Fincorp files draft papers for Rs 3,000 cr IPO to boost capital base
news.description: Muthoot Fincorp filed draft papers with Sebi for a Rs 3,000 crore IPO.  The company aims to strengthen its capital base and fund business growth.  Its gold loan business has seen significant expansion over two decades.  Muthoot Fincorp reported increased profits and revenue in the last fiscal year.

news.title: US deficit reaches $1.8 trillion in first 10 months of fiscal 2026
news.description: US federal budget deficit hit a record $432 billion in July, taking the fiscal 2026 shortfall to $1.799 trillion in the first 10 months. Higher government spending and weaker tariff revenues have intensified pressure on the US fiscal position, with two months remaining in the fiscal year.

news.title: Gold prices rise Rs 1,400/gram in 2 days; silver dips marginally despite soft US inflation. What should investors do?
news.description: Gold prices rose Rs 1,400 in two sessions, while MCX silver slipped marginally as softer US inflation lowered expectations of a near-term Fed rate hike. Investors now await US PPI data for further cues, while analysts expect profit booking in gold.
